business_problem: Headquartered in Boca Raton, Florida, Proforce Pest Control provides residential pest control across 13 branches in five Southeastern and Mid-Atlantic states. The business grew out of a series of acquisitions, inheriting a team of 80 field employees and thousands of customers. But, crucially, it was without an established technology infrastructure needed to run the business effectively.
solution_summary: Proforce had its data infrastructure up and running in just a few months. Charles Fox, Proforce's Chief Strategy Officer, describes BigQuery as "the central nervous system of everything we do." The company built custom Python pipelines running on Cloud Run to pull customer data straight into BigQuery. Looker connects directly to the same dataset, meaning every dashboard and report across the business—from dispatcher screens to executive reporting—draws on the same live data. That live connection enables Proforce to automatically remove past-due accounts from service lists before daily routes are built, eliminating wasted visits and unpaid work. "It sounds basic," says Shorr, "but it's incredibly impactful." By deploying AI-powered transcription and summarization through Gemini in Google Workspace, Proforce eliminated that step in almost all cases, saving roughly 50 hours of agent time every day.
